# Key set of the AxiTrace Shopware plugin purchase payload
# (shopware-plugin/src/Normalizer/OrderEventNormalizer.php, normalize(), return array :325-355 and the
# `data` block built above it). The PrestaShop normalizer must produce the same keys (A38), so
# event-worker needs no PrestaShop-specific code.
#
# Format: <section> <key> [optional]
#   top      top-level key, always present
#   data     key of `data`; "optional" = omitted when the order carries no value
#   client   key of `data.client`
#   product  key of each `data.products[]`
top event
top eventSalt
top event_id
top transactionId
top orderId
top workspace_public_key
top source
top timestamp
top ip
top userAgent
top pluginVersion
top sdkVersion
top userId
top sessionId
top billingCity
top billingCountry
top billingZip
top billingState
top data
data client
data products
data revenue
data value
data orderNumber
data tax
data shipping
data valueBasis
data taxesIncluded optional
data paymentInfo optional
data fbp optional
data fbc optional
data ttp optional
data rdt_uuid optional
data obref optional
data gclid optional
data gbraid optional
data wbraid optional
data ttclid optional
data rdt_cid optional
data oppref optional
data msclkid optional
data twclid optional
data epik optional
data li_fat_id optional
data sccid optional
data _ga optional
data ga_session_id optional
data consent optional
data url optional
client email
client phone
client firstName
client lastName
product productId
product externalId optional
product sku
product name
product quantity
product price
product currency
product variant optional
product brand optional
product category optional
product pinterest_id optional
product unitCost optional
